function.name: search_insurance_products
function.description: Searches for available insurance products such as health insurance, car insurance, and life insurance, providing details on coverage and premiums.

insurance_type.description: The type of insurance to search for (e.g., 'health', 'car', 'life').

min_premium.description: The minimum premium amount for filtering products (optional).

max_premium.description: The maximum premium amount for filtering products (optional).

function.name: view_insurance_product_details
function.description: Views detailed information about a specific insurance product, including coverage, premium, terms, and exclusions.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the insurance product to view its details.

function.name: apply_for_insurance
function.description: Submits an application to purchase an insurance product, specifying the product, coverage amount, and policy duration.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the insurance product being applied for.

coverage_amount.description: The amount of coverage to be selected for the insurance product.

policy_duration.description: The duration of the insurance policy (e.g., '1 year', '5 years').

function.name: pay_insurance_premium
function.description: Handles the payment of premiums for selected insurance products, involving sensitive financial data and transaction security.

application_id.description: The unique identifier of the insurance application for which the premium is being paid.

payment_amount.description: The total amount to be paid for the premium.

payment_method.description: The method used for payment (e.g., 'credit card', 'bank transfer').

function.name: view_insurance_contract
function.description: Fetches the insurance contract for a selected policy, including terms, coverage details, and exclusions.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the insurance contract to be viewed.

function.name: download_insurance_contract
function.description: Downloads the insurance contract in PDF format for offline access.

contract_id.description: The unique identifier of the insurance contract to be downloaded.

function.name: submit_claim
function.description: Submits a claim request for an insurance policy, uploading necessary documents like medical receipts or accident proof.

policy_id.description: The unique identifier of the insurance policy for which the claim is being submitted.

claim_documents.description: A list of documents required for the claim submission (e.g., medical receipts, accident report).

function.name: view_claim_status
function.description: Checks the status of a submitted claim, including approval or rejection details.

claim_id.description: The unique identifier of the claim to check its status.

function.name: view_policy_details
function.description: Views the details of a user's active insurance policy, including policy number, coverage, and premium details.

policy_id.description: The unique identifier of the insurance policy to view.

function.name: update_personal_info
function.description: Updates the user's personal information, such as contact details, address, and other sensitive data.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose information is to be updated.

contact_number.description: The updated contact number for the user.

email_address.description: The updated email address for the user.

address.description: The updated address for the user.
